title: Social Sign In
description: "Continue with Google / Apple / X / …" plus an optional email link, in one form. Pick the providers and their order; the first `featured` ones get a full-width button with their name, the rest share a row of icon buttons, and the provider the visitor used…

## @interlace/social-sign-in

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/social-sign-in.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/social-sign-in';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/social-sign-in

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
